syllabus_topics: Transient response in linear electric circuits - introduction
Circuits with distributed parameters - main concepts
differential equations of a homogeneous line
sinusoidal steady-state process in a homogeneous line, input impedance

Non-linear electric circuits 
 steady-state regimes, basic laws and methods for analysis
periodic regimes, inert and non-inert electric circuit elements, methods for analysis
transient processes, methods for analysis, etc.

assessment_methods.method: individual course work (written and oral defense)
exam (written and oral, practical problems and theoretical questions)

assessment_rules: Students receive an individual course work in the middle of the semester, which must be presented in written form and defended orally at the end of the semester. The final assessment is based on a written and oral exam containing practical problems and theoretical questions.
